initial_state: New accessible Untitled_MD.zprj workspace, no authored pieces or avatar visible, Fabric tab active. No user files opened.
surface: native macOS main menubar, including nested AX-exposed entries in this empty-project state
identity_rule: MDUI- plus first 12 uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 characters of surface plus full exact label path separated by NUL. IDs persist across insertion/reordering; a renamed path requires an alias review.
evidence_policy: Full native Computer Use AX menu-action records and selected-app screenshots are retained privately and independently matched against all reviewed paths/disabled markers. REA binds the live workspace/build; its selected-window AX tree does not contain the native macOS menubar.
state_limitations: Disabled markers are preserved as exposed by CUA. Absence of a disabled marker is not promoted to an independently verified enabled state.
Checked states and menu shortcuts are null unless separately observed.
Disabled section headings, empty submenus and commands may be indistinguishable as leaf-like nodes; leaf count is not a product-feature denominator.
Leading spaces in displayed group labels were normalized; hierarchy follows actual AX submenu nesting, not visual padding.
Edit > Context Menu is a menu-based catalog, not an executed canvas right-click context menu.
No menu presence is a successful end-to-end workflow or reference-parity claim.
Account/activation/storefront and OS service entries are inventoried without account actions; replacement scope must be assessed separately.
